content.thinking: The bug is in UsersService.update, where a missing photo gets set to null and so clears the stored one. I'm checking how the repository applies that value next.

candidates.explanation: The photo branch has `else if (updateUserDto.photo === undefined) { photo = null; }`. When a profile edit sends only firstName, `photo` is undefined in the DTO. The service then sets photo to null instead of leaving it undefined, which means 'don't change'. The null is passed to the repository update, so the avatar is cleared. Re-uploading the picture sets it again. The check should be `=== null`, so only an explicit null removes the photo. The email handling just above uses that pattern.

fix.description: Change the condition so only an explicit null clears the photo. An omitted photo stays undefined and is left unchanged: `} else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`
